Hegseth Could Be the Third Cabinet Secretary to be Impeached. What Happened to the Others?

Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth could become the third Cabinet secretary to be impeached in U.S. history after a Republican lawmaker reintroduced a resolution forcing the House to take up the vote.
